body:
When `upload-pages-artifact` and `deploy-pages` run in the same job, as in the [static starter workflow](https://github.com/actions/starter-workflows/blob/main/pages/static.yml), the artifact lookup can come back empty for an artifact that was finalized a fraction of a second earlier. The versions match (upload-pages-artifact v5.0.0, deploy-pages v5.0.1), so this is not the version mismatch discussed in #305.

From [the failing job](https://github.com/ctbot000/kids-world/actions/runs/37629390230/job/112824313758):

```
2026-10-07T13:43:59.4747863Z Artifact github-pages successfully finalized. Artifact ID 11486441618
2026-10-07T13:43:59.7518839Z Fetching artifact metadata for "github-pages" in this workflow run
2026-10-07T13:43:59.9097421Z Found 0 artifact(s)
Error: No artifacts named "github-pages" were found for this workflow run. Ensure artifacts are uploaded with actions/upload-artifact@v4 or later.
```

It is intermittent. That repository deployed 63 times with this layout and 62 runs found the artifact, 7 of them after a shorter gap between finalizing and listing (221–276 ms) than the failing run (277 ms). A new run of the same commit deployed normally.

Re-running, as the error message advises, cannot recover this layout: the re-run uploads a second `github-pages` artifact to the same run, and the lookup then fails with `Multiple artifacts named "github-pages" were unexpectedly found for this workflow run. Artifact count is 2.` (#338).

Possible fixes:

- When no artifact matches, retry `listArtifacts()` a few times with a short backoff before failing.
- Deploying by the `artifact_id` that upload-pages-artifact outputs (#399) would skip the lookup altogether.
- The static starter is the only Pages starter that uploads and deploys in one job; the others upload in a separate build job, so the lookup happens seconds later. Moving the upload into an earlier job fixed it for us.
title: Intermittent "No artifacts named github-pages" when deploy-pages runs right after upload-pages-artifact in the same job
